description: Meshtastic client for the M5Stack CardputerZero

store.summary: Send and receive Meshtastic messages over LoRa on the CardputerZero.
store.description: A Meshtastic client for the M5Stack CardputerZero. Threaded messaging over the LoRa mesh with delivery status and resend, a nodes list and radar map, quick (canned) messages, send/request location, traceroute, and channel-QR share. A native LVGL UI drives a Python radio supervisor that owns the SX1262 Cap and meshtasticd. Requires the Cap LoRa-1262 (install meshtasticd and the meshtastic library separately).
